{{Short description|Italian experimental physicist}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=November 2022}}
'''Francesca Ferlaino''' (born 1977) is an Italian-Austrian [[Experimental physics|experimental physicist]] known for her research on [[quantum]] matter. She is a professor of physics at the [[University of Innsbruck]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Experimental Physics Innsbruck |url=https://www.uibk.ac.at/exphys/ |website=University of Innsbruck |access-date=26 April 2021}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Francesca Ferlaino|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ysSwOFoAAAAJ&hl=en|access-date=27 April 2021|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>

==Career==
Francesca Ferlaino was born in [[Naples]], Italy. She studied [[physics]] at the [[University of Naples Federico II]] (1995–2000) and was an undergraduate research fellow at the [[International School for Advanced Studies]] (SISSA) in [[Trieste]] (1999–2000). She did a PhD in physics at the [[University of Florence]] and the [[European Laboratory for Non-Linear Spectroscopy]] (LENS) (2001–2004). In 2007, she moved to the [[University of Innsbruck]], [[Austria]], where she was a research and teaching associate and started her own research group. In 2014 she became a professor of physics at the [[University of Innsbruck]] and research director at the [[Institute for Quantum Optics and Quantum Information]] (IQOQI) of the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Francesca Ferlaino – Dipolar Quantum Gases |url=http://www.erbium.at/FF/?page_id=1859 |website=www.erbium.at |access-date=26 April 2021}}</ref>

==Research==
Her research activity explores quantum phenomena in atomic gases at ultralow temperatures with contributions spanning topics including quantum matter of atoms and molecules and few-body and [[scattering]] physics. Over the last years, she has focused specifically on the strongly magnetic, and rather unexplored, [[Erbium]] and [[Dysprosium]] atomic species, realizing in 2012 the world's first [[Bose-Einstein condensation]] of Erbium,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Aikawa |first1=K. |last2=Frisch |first2=A. |last3=Mark |first3=M. |last4=Baier |first4=S. |last5=Rietzler |first5=A. |last6=Grimm |first6=R. |last7=Ferlaino |first7=F. |title=Bose-Einstein Condensation of Erbium |journal=Physical Review Letters |date=21 May 2012 |volume=108 |issue=21 |article-number=210401 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.108.210401|pmid=23003221 |arxiv=1204.1725 |bibcode=2012PhRvL.108u0401A }}</ref> and in 2018, the first dipolar quantum mixture of Erbium and Dysprosium.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Trautmann |first1=A. |last2=Ilzhöfer |first2=P. |last3=Durastante |first3=G. |last4=Politi |first4=C. |last5=Sohmen |first5=M. |last6=Mark |first6=M. J. |last7=Ferlaino |first7=F. |title=Dipolar Quantum Mixtures of Erbium and Dysprosium Atoms |journal=Physical Review Letters |date=21 November 2018 |volume=121 |issue=21 |article-number=213601 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.121.213601|pmid=30517813 |arxiv=1807.07555 |bibcode=2018PhRvL.121u3601T }}</ref> In 2019, she was able to prepare the first long-lived [[supersolid]] state, an elusive and paradoxical state where [[superfluid]] flow and [[crystal]] rigidity coexist.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Chomaz |first1=L. |last2=Petter |first2=D. |last3=Ilzhöfer |first3=P. |last4=Natale |first4=G. |last5=Trautmann |first5=A. |last6=Politi |first6=C. |last7=Durastante |first7=G. |last8=van Bijnen |first8=R. M. W. |last9=Patscheider |first9=A. |last10=Sohmen |first10=M. |last11=Mark |first11=M. J. |last12=Ferlaino |first12=F. |title=Long-Lived and Transient Supersolid Behaviors in Dipolar Quantum Gases |journal=Physical Review X |date=19 April 2019 |volume=9 |issue=2 |article-number=021012 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevX.9.021012 | arxiv=1903.04375 |doi-access=free |bibcode=2019PhRvX...9b1012C }}</ref> With these systems, she has explored a variety of many-body quantum phenomena dictated by the long-range and anisotropic dipolar interaction among the atoms. In 2021, she created supersolid states along two dimensions.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Norcia |first1=M. A. |last2=Politi |first2=C. |last3=Lauritz |first3=K. |last4=Poli |first4=E. |last5=Sohmen |first5=M. |last6=Mark |first6=M. J. |last7=Bisset |first7=R. N. |last8=Santos |first8=L. |last9=Ferlaino |first9=F. |title=Two-dimensional supersolidity in a dipolar quantum gas |journal=Nature |date=18 August 2021 |volume=596 |issue=7872 |pages=357–361 |doi=10.1038/s41586-021-03725-7 |pmid=34408330 |arxiv=2102.05555 |bibcode=2021Natur.596..357N }}</ref> In 2024 her team reported the observation of [[Quantum vortex|quantum vortices]] in the supersolid phase<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Casotti |first1=Eva |last2=Poli |first2=Elena |last3=Klaus |first3=Lauritz |last4=Litvinov |first4=Andrea |last5=Ulm |first5=Clemens |last6=Politi |first6=Claudia |last7=Mark |first7=Manfred J. |last8=Bland |first8=Thomas |last9=Ferlaino |first9=Francesca |date=2024 |title=Observation of vortices in a dipolar supersolid |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08149-7 |journal=Nature |volume=635 |issue=8038 |pages=327–331 |doi=10.1038/s41586-024-08149-7 |pmid=39506121 |issn=0028-0836|arxiv=2403.18510 |bibcode=2024Natur.635..327C }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Savitsky |first=Zack |date=2024-11-06 |title=Physicists Spot Quantum Tornadoes Twirling in a 'Supersolid' |url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/physicists-spot-quantum-tornadoes-twirling-in-a-supersolid-20241106/ |access-date=2024-11-28 |website=Quanta Magazine |language=en}}</ref>

DeWitt-Morette / École de Physique des Houches: Francesca Ferlaino {{!}} Lauréats {{!}} Prix et médailles {{!}} Encourager la vie scientifique |url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/en/Laureats/prix-cecile-dewitt-morette-ecole-de-physique-des-houches-2019-francesca-ferlaino.html |website=www.academie-sciences.fr |access-date=26 April 2021}}</ref> the Junior BEC Award (2019),<ref>{{cite web |title=BEC Award |url=https://bec2021.org/bec-award/ |website=Bose-Einstein Condensation 2021 |access-date=26 April 2021 |date=30 September 2020 |archive-date=26 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210426194504/https://bec2021.org/bec-award/ }}</ref>  the [[Feltrinelli Prize]] (2017)<ref>{{cite news |title=Accademia dei Lincei: alla napoletana Francesca Ferlaino il premio Antonio Feltrinelli |url=https://www.ilmattino.it/primopiano/scuola_e_universita/accademia_lincei_napoletana_francesca_ferlaino_premio_antonio_feltrinelli_la_fisica-3356530.html |access-date=26 April 2021 |work=www.ilmattino.it |date=9 November 2017 |language=it}}</ref> and the [[Erwin Schrödinger Prize]] (2017).<ref>{{cite web |title=Francesca Ferlaino |url=https://stipendien.oeaw.ac.at/preise/naturwissenschaften/erwin-schroedinger-preis/preistraegerinnen/francesca-ferlaino |website=stipendien.oeaw.ac.at |access-date=26 April 2021 |archive-date=26 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210426194505/https://stipendien.oeaw.ac.at/preise/naturwissenschaften/erwin-schroedinger-preis/preistraegerinnen/francesca-ferlaino }}</ref> She was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Physical Society]] (APS) in 2019 "for ground-breaking experiments on dipolar quantum gases of erbium atoms, including the attainment of quantum degeneracy of bosons and fermions, studies on quantum-chaotical scattering, the formation of quantum droplets, and investigations on the roton spectrum".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=2019&unit_id=DAMOP&institution=|title=Fellows elected in 2019 from the Division of Atomic, Molecular and Optical |url=https://www.oeaw.ac.at/esq/home/news-detail/francesca-ferlaino-elected-fellow-of-the-american-physical-society-aps |website=Österreichische Akademie der Wissenschaften |access-date=29 April 2021 |date=9 October 2019}}</ref>

She was named Austria's Scientist of the Year 2025<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2026-01-07 |title=Francesca Ferlaino named Austrian Scientist of the Year |url=https://iqoqi.at/en/current/news/1042-francesca-ferlaino-named-austrian-scientist-of-the-year |access-date=2026-01-08 |website=Institute for Quantum Optics and Quantum Information (IQOQI) |language=en-gb}}</ref> and Austrian of the Year 2024 in research<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stani |first=Tina |last2=Köttritsch |first2=Michael |date=2024-10-23 |title=Die Österreicherinnen des Jahres 2024 stehen fest |url=https://www.diepresse.com/18999955/die-oesterreicherinnen-des-jahres-2024-stehen-fest |access-date=2026-01-08 |website=Die Presse |language=de}}</ref>. Since 2026, she is a full member of the Austrian Academy of Sciences.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-03-26 |title=Neue Mitglieder gewählt: 46 Spitzenforschende verstärken die ÖAW |url=https://www.oeaw.ac.at/en/news/neue-mitglieder-gewaehlt-46-spitzenforschende-verstaerken-die-oeaw-1 |access-date=2026-03-27 |website=www.oeaw.ac.at |language=de}}</ref>
